# Shift handover: life-advice-chats · 2026-11-12 05:18
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. No files to read; this was a chat-only session (no code). Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (`quick` mode, no exam run)

## 0 · Read these first (required)
None. No files were created or edited. The repo holds only commit `43f481f start` and `.claude/` [verified: git status/log].

## 1 · Status
🟢 There is no open technical work. This was a series of personal-advice chats dated 2023-01-02 to 2023-02-25 (the dates come from the "[Chat session on …]" headers). The most recent topic is emotionally sensitive (see §2, the breakup). If the user comes back, it will most likely be to continue a topic or to ask what they told me earlier.

## 2 · Picture
The user asked about many unrelated topics: Tamil language and culture, a community-theatre production of Les Misérables, photo printing and Alexa, audiobooks and sci-fi/fantasy, a trip to Zaragoza, music gear (keyboard, amp, pedals, ukulele, guitar, harmonica), a "tell me a lie" game, and a painful breakup. No decisions are pending except gear purchases the user said they would try out (§3). Answers were long, list-style recommendations, and the user never complained about the length.

**Breakup thread (2023-02-25 09:27–09:43, the most sensitive one)** [user said]: The user is a college senior working on a draining research paper. Their ex graduated from the same university the year before and works full time. The relationship lasted seven months, almost always at the ex's place, with sex but never a proper date, even though the user asked for one repeatedly. The ex would not commit or trust the user, and felt "easily replaceable" even though the user said they were in love. He objected to the user working on the paper at his place, got upset by slow text replies or by the user not wanting to be touched for a moment, and refused treatment for what the user calls his "sex addiction". He had relationships in high school and at 20, plus some casual encounters, a couple of them while drunk. He "dreamed about" the user. He had not reached out for "the past few days". The user cries when thinking about him and misses his voice and touch. They asked whether to reach out; I said it depends, to consider their own well-being, and suggested a friend or therapist. My stance throughout: I can't know his reasons, it is not the user's fault, grieving is normal. The ex's pronoun is "he" (the user's own word). The user's own gender was never stated, so use they/them.

## 3 · Next actions (the user's own stated plans; nothing pending for the agent)
1. Try the **Korg B1** and the **Roland FP-10** keyboards (said 2023-02-25).
2. Try the **Fender Acoustic 40** and the **Fishman Loudbox Mini** amps. They are also considering the **AER Compact 60**, but it is "a bit above my budget" (2023-02-25).
3. Wants a **compressor pedal** to even out dynamics and add sustain. Asked for recommendations; no choice made yet.
4. Sell the **Hohner Special 20** harmonica, probably on eBay (said 2023-02-01).
5. Download the **Zaragoza Tourist App** (said 2023-01-26).
6. Les Mis (from 2023-01-02): pick up the script from the theatre office "today" (2023-01-02), write a program bio, label the set pieces, check ensemble costumes.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| An "obvious" lie ("The sky is purple") | User: "That is a bad lie it is too obvious. Tell me a subtle lie" | never; when the user asks for a lie, make it subtle |
| Guessing the ex's motives as fact | I repeatedly said only he can answer; keep it that way, and don't blame the user | user asks for speculation explicitly |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** [all user said; dates are the session dates]:
- College **senior** with a research paper that has been draining them (2023-02-25). Recently out of a 7-month situationship (see §2).
- Acts in or helps run a **community-theatre production of Les Misérables** (2023-01-02). The full dress rehearsal was the night before, 2023-01-01, and was "a bit of a disaster": the sound system failed and the set changes had problems. Opening night is "next Friday": said on Mon 2023-01-02, so 2023-01-06 or 2023-01-13 (ambiguous). Interested in Tamil language, literature, cinema and music (2023-01-02).
- **Printer**: set up a new wireless printer "on Sunday, March 12th" after weeks of procrastinating, and has been printing non-stop since. Uploaded vacation photos to **Google Photos on March 15th**, organized into albums. Bought an **Alexa smart speaker on March 25th** and uses it to control the TV. Note: these March dates were said in the 2023-01-08 session, so the year is unclear; record them as stated. Sometimes prefers a **matte finish** on prints. The printer brand was never stated.
- **Audiobooks**: "non-stop for three months" as of 2023-01-23 (so since about late Oct 2022). Averages 2–3 h/day during morning and evening commutes and lunch breaks. Their sleep schedule has suffered. Liked *The Overstory*. Currently reading *Dune* and enjoying the *Three-Body Problem* series. Exploring sci-fi and fantasy, including blends with mystery or thriller.
- **Zaragoza**: planning to visit its historical landmarks (2023-01-26).
- **Music** (music room at home):
  - Owns a **Yamaha P-125** keyboard and wants to upgrade.
  - Keyboard budget/needs changed between sessions. 2023-02-01: $500–1000, piano + some synth, *prefers weighted keys*, wants recording + USB, portability doesn't matter. 2023-02-25 (replaces the earlier one): about **$1,000**, plays mostly **classical and jazz**, wants a good piano sound, "not sure if [weighted keys are] necessary".
  - Owns a **Taylor GS Mini** guitar and a **Fender Mustang I V2** practice amp. Has played the GS Mini more since getting the Mustang. Wants an amp for practice and small gigs.
  - **Guitar service**: on 2023-02-01 they planned to take the GS Mini to **Joe, a guitar tech at Guitar Central**, "by the end of this month" because the high action hurt their left hand. On **2023-02-25** they said they took it in "today", and the action is now "perfect" and comfortable.
  - **Ukulele**: started lessons with their friend **Rachel** on **2023-02-01** ("today"). Struggles with fingerpicking because their fingers get tangled; Rachel gives them exercises.
  - Owns a Hohner Special 20 harmonica they haven't played "in ages".

| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Any lie will do | Wanted a believable one | Make requested lies subtle and plausible | "too obvious. Tell me a subtle lie" |
| (none else) | The user once accidentally wrote an assistant-style reply and fixed it themselves (2023-01-02) | No rule needed | "I was supposed to respond as the user" |

## 6b · What I told the user (they may ask again), including known errors
- **Tamil**: I said it has about 80M speakers and is the "most widely spoken Dravidian language" (**wrong**: Telugu has more speakers). I listed Kamala Das as a Tamil writer (**wrong**: she wrote in Malayalam/English) and *Baahubali* as Tamil cinema (it was made in Telugu and Tamil). My list of five resources included Tamil Virtual Academy and Tamil Wikipedia.
- **Les Mis**: I gave advice on sound and set changes, a contingency plan with a "fix-it kit", a costume checklist, and a bio template. My sample bio used "Emily Johnson as Éponine".
- **Printing**: I gave quality tiers (Draft 300 dpi … Best Photo 4800 dpi), paper sizes 4x6/5x7/8x10/11x14, and matte papers (Epson Ultra Premium Matte 240 gsm, Canon Matte, HP Everyday Matte). I also described an "HP Printer Skill" for Alexa with recipe printing from Allrecipes, Yummly and Epicurious. Treat those Alexa skill details as **unverified and probably invented**.
- **Books**: I gave 12 Overstory-like picks (incl. Braiding Sweetgrass, Hidden Life of Trees, The Word for World is Forest). I listed sci-fi/fantasy series (Expanse, Mistborn, Stormlight, Kingkiller…), SF-fantasy blends (Broken Empire, Lightbringer, Powder Mage, Long Earth…) and mystery/thriller picks (Illuminae, Ancillary Justice, House of Shattered Wings, The Power…). One answer contained the typo "China Miéavirus".
- **Zaragoza**: I said to use buses or trams, walk, or bike. I suggested Roman/Islamic/Mudéjar/Renaissance/Gothic routes, apps (Zaragoza Tourist App etc.), and food spots (Casa Lac, El Tubo, Bodegas Almau, La Republicana, Pastelería Tolosana). Some details are dubious (e.g. "Medina Azahara Museum" is in Córdoba, not Zaragoza).
- **Keyboards**: my prices were inconsistent between sessions. Korg B1 was $499, then $699; Roland FP-10 $799, then $999; FP-30 $999, then $799. I called Roland GO:KEYS weighted (it is not). I also suggested Yamaha P-255 and CP4, and Korg Grandstage/D1.
- **Amps**: I first suggested electric tube amps (Fender Deluxe Reverb, Hot Rod Deluxe IV, Mesa Mark IV, Orange Crush Pro, Quilter Aviator). Then for the acoustic GS Mini: Fender Acoustic 40 ($299), Fishman Loudbox Mini ($299), AER Compact 60 ($499), with 20–40 W as the sweet spot for small gigs.
- **Pedals**: MXR Dyna Comp ($99), Keeley Compressor ($179), "Teletronix LA-2A" ($299; **wrong**: that is a studio rack unit, not a pedal). Others: Strymon BlueSky reverb, EHX Nano Clone chorus, TC Flashback delay.
- **Ukulele**: I gave practice and chord-change tips (C-G-Am-F, metronome) and fingerpicking tips (relax, finger assignment, start with thumb + index).
- **GS Mini service**: I gave a checklist (action, neck relief, frets, saddle, intonation, electronics, tuners).
- **Harmonica sale**: research eBay/Reverb completed listings, price used at 20–30% off new, take well-lit close-ups.
- **Sleep and audiobooks**: set a 20–30 min bedtime timer, choose calmer books at night. I said 2–3 h/day is a fine amount.

## 9 · Gotchas
- Session timestamps are not in order: the 2023-02-25 **09:27** breakup chat comes after the 13:54 gear chat in the transcript. Use the header dates, not the order of the transcript.
- The keyboard requirements changed between 2023-02-01 and 2023-02-25 (see §5). Use the later ones.
- The guitar service is **done** (2023-02-25), not planned.

question: How many days had passed since I started taking ukulele lessons when I decided to take my acoustic guitar to the guitar tech for servicing?
gold: 24 days. 25 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.
answer:
**24 days.**

- **2023-02-01:** You started ukulele lessons with Rachel.
- **2023-02-25:** You took the Taylor GS Mini to Joe at Guitar Central. Afterwards the action was "perfect" and comfortable.

From Feb 1 to Feb 25 is 24 days.

If you mean the day you first decided to get it serviced rather than the day you took it in, the answer is 0 days. You told me on 2023-02-01, the same day the lessons started, that you planned to take it in "by the end of this month" because the high action was hurting your left hand.
